system.description:
Ring, Legendary

While wearing this ring, you can expend 1 of its 3 charges to cast Wish from it. The ring becomes nonmagical when you use the last charge.

notes: not automated (utility): using it spends its cost; its description says the rest
effect: "Wish Stress" change system.abilities.str.value (downgrade) not converted
effect: "Wish Stress" (its own changes) not converted
